name: dashboard
tagline_zh: 你说“把X放上首页”，它立刻重排卡片、调布局、改样式。不用翻代码，不用拖组件，一句话让仪表盘变你想要的样子。
tagline_en: Say "put X on my dashboard" and it rearranges cards, tweaks layout, restyles. No code, no dragging—just words.
desc_en: Update the agent's Home dashboard. Use when the user says "update my dashboard", "redesign my home", "put X on the dashboard", or "/dashboard".
why_zh: 同类工具要你描述布局，它直接理解你的意图并动手改，连卡片优先级都替你想到。
why_en: Others ask you to describe layout; it infers intent and edits, even prioritizing cards for you.
